title: Waypoint Beacon Anchoring
description: Waypoint Beacon Anchoring is a navigation ability in the Voice-Guided Spatial Navigation database. Places named voice beacons at fixed positions so a listener can walk toward a spoken target. Each beacon stores a name, coordinates, and a trigger radius; the guidance loop announces the nearest beacon and refreshes the cue as the listener moves. It takes listener position, beacon list and produces spoken cue, distance, bearing. Tunable parameters: radius 2–50 m, cue interval 2–10 s. Guarantee: cues are never older than one position update.

fields.mechanism: Each beacon stores a name, coordinates, and a trigger radius; the guidance loop announces the nearest beacon and refreshes the cue as the listener moves.
fields.guarantees: cues are never older than one position update

title: Corridor Narration
description: Corridor Narration is a navigation ability in the Voice-Guided Spatial Navigation database. Narrates a straight path segment in plain words with distance callouts. The segment is split into distance bands; each band crossing triggers a short spoken update with the remaining distance. It takes segment start, segment end, current position and produces band-crossing announcements. Tunable parameters: band size 5–25 m. Guarantee: no band is ever skipped, even at speed.

fields.mechanism: The segment is split into distance bands; each band crossing triggers a short spoken update with the remaining distance.
fields.inputs: segment start, segment end, current position
fields.guarantees: no band is ever skipped, even at speed

title: Landmark Referencing
description: Landmark Referencing is a navigation ability in the Voice-Guided Spatial Navigation database. Names real landmarks near the listener so spoken directions stay human and verifiable. Landmarks are indexed by position and salience; the cue builder picks the closest landmark on the correct side of travel. It takes listener position, heading, landmark index and produces spoken cue with landmark reference. Tunable parameters: max landmark distance 200 m. Guarantee: every cue names a landmark within line of sight.

fields.mechanism: Landmarks are indexed by position and salience; the cue builder picks the closest landmark on the correct side of travel.
fields.guarantees: every cue names a landmark within line of sight

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Distance Callouts
description: Distance Callouts is a navigation ability in the Voice-Guided Spatial Navigation database. Reads out remaining distance at fixed milestones so the listener can pace themselves. Milestones are precomputed from the route length; each crossing emits one short cue and is then retired. It takes route length, current position and produces milestone cues. Tunable parameters: milestone spacing 10–100 m. Guarantee: each milestone fires exactly once per route.

fields.mechanism: Milestones are precomputed from the route length; each crossing emits one short cue and is then retired.
fields.guarantees: each milestone fires exactly once per route

title: Bearing Announcements
description: Bearing Announcements is a navigation ability in the Voice-Guided Spatial Navigation database. Announces the compass bearing to the next target in plain cardinal words. The raw bearing is quantized to 16 compass points and spoken with the distance, e.g. northeast, 40 meters. It takes listener position, target position and produces compass cue. Tunable parameters: 16-point quantization. Guarantee: bearing error stays under 11.25 degrees.

fields.mechanism: The raw bearing is quantized to 16 compass points and spoken with the distance, e.g. northeast, 40 meters.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Obstacle Warnings
description: Obstacle Warnings is a navigation ability in the Voice-Guided Spatial Navigation database. Warns the listener of a known obstacle before they reach it, with a side to pass on. Obstacles are stored as circles with a severity; entering the warning radius triggers a cue naming the obstacle and the safe side. It takes obstacle map, listener position and produces warning cue. Tunable parameters: warning radius 5–30 m. Guarantee: warnings always precede arrival, never follow it.

fields.mechanism: Obstacles are stored as circles with a severity; entering the warning radius triggers a cue naming the obstacle and the safe side.
fields.guarantees: warnings always precede arrival, never follow it

title: Route Replanning
description: Route Replanning is a navigation ability in the Voice-Guided Spatial Navigation database. Replans the spoken route automatically when the listener leaves the planned path. A new route is computed from the current position to the original destination and the first cue is spoken immediately. It takes current position, destination, walkable graph and produces new route, first cue. Tunable parameters: replan latency under 2 s. Guarantee: the destination is never dropped during replanning.

fields.mechanism: A new route is computed from the current position to the original destination and the first cue is spoken immediately.
fields.guarantees: the destination is never dropped during replanning

title: Multi-Floor Guidance
description: Multi-Floor Guidance is a navigation ability in the Voice-Guided Spatial Navigation database. Guides the listener between floors with spoken stair, ramp, and elevator instructions. Floor transitions are modeled as special edges with their own cue phrases; the announcer switches vocabulary at the transition point. It takes building graph, current floor and produces floor-transition cues. Tunable parameters: announce 10 m before the transition. Guarantee: the target floor is confirmed after every transition.

title: Destination Confirmation
description: Destination Confirmation is a navigation ability in the Voice-Guided Spatial Navigation database. Confirms arrival out loud and stops guidance so the listener is never left guessing. Arrival is declared when the distance to the destination falls below the arrival radius for two consecutive position updates. It takes destination, position stream and produces arrival confirmation. Tunable parameters: arrival radius 3 m. Guarantee: arrival is confirmed twice before guidance stops.

title: Quiet-Zone Handling
description: Quiet-Zone Handling is a navigation ability in the Voice-Guided Spatial Navigation database. Lowers cue volume and shortens phrases in marked quiet zones such as libraries. Quiet zones are polygons with a volume profile; entering one switches the voice engine to whisper mode until exit. It takes quiet-zone polygons, position and produces whisper-mode cues. Tunable parameters: volume 20–40% of normal. Guarantee: no loud cue ever fires inside a quiet zone.

fields.mechanism: Quiet zones are polygons with a volume profile; entering one switches the voice engine to whisper mode until exit.
fields.guarantees: no loud cue ever fires inside a quiet zone

title: Hazard Escalation
description: Hazard Escalation is a navigation ability in the Voice-Guided Spatial Navigation database. Escalates the voice from calm to urgent as the listener nears a hazard. Hazard distance bands map to voice urgency levels; the cue repeats faster and louder as the distance shrinks. It takes hazard list, listener position and produces escalating warnings. Tunable parameters: 3 urgency levels. Guarantee: urgency never decreases while distance shrinks.

title: Group Tour Sync
description: Group Tour Sync is a navigation ability in the Voice-Guided Spatial Navigation database. Keeps a walking group together by announcing the slowest member's position to everyone. Tunable parameters: hold radius 15 m. Guarantee: no member is ever left behind the hold radius.

title: Night Mode Guidance
description: Night Mode Guidance is a navigation ability in the Voice-Guided Spatial Navigation database. Switches to step-counted guidance after dark when landmarks are hard to see. Night mode replaces landmark cues with step counts and turn angles, calibrated to the listener's stride. It takes stride length, route and produces step-count cues. Tunable parameters: stride calibration 0.5–1.0 m. Guarantee: step totals stay within 5% of the true distance.

title: Emergency Exit Routing
description: Emergency Exit Routing is a navigation ability in the Voice-Guided Spatial Navigation database. Speaks the fastest safe route to the nearest exit on demand. Exits are ranked by distance and hazard clearance; the cue names the exit and repeats until arrival is confirmed. It takes exit list, hazard map, position and produces exit route cues. Tunable parameters: repeat every 8 s until arrival. Guarantee: the nearest safe exit is always chosen first.

title: Indoor-Outdoor Handoff
description: Indoor-Outdoor Handoff is a navigation ability in the Voice-Guided Spatial Navigation database. Hands guidance smoothly between indoor beacons and outdoor positioning without a gap. The handoff manager blends both position sources near the boundary and switches the cue vocabulary once the fix is stable. It takes indoor beacons, GNSS fix and produces continuous cues across the boundary. Tunable parameters: handoff zone 10 m. Guarantee: no cue gap longer than 3 s during handoff.
